 Promoting Healthy Living Clean is more than appearance 
Why Choose All American Carpet Cleaning 
Your carpet is the biggest filter in your home. It traps dust, dander, and allergens until the filter fills up, and then those particles go airborne again. That's why All American treats cleaning as health maintenance, not just appearance. Promoting Healthy Living is the whole point. 
Hot water extraction is a cleaning method that injects heated water and cleaning solution into carpet under pressure, then immediately vacuums out the moisture along with dissolved soil. The IICRC S100 standard recognizes it as the deepest-cleaning method for most residential carpet. 
Pet stains and kid messes get the same customized approach: we use a blacklight to find pet stains other methods miss, then treat each spot based on the situation and severity. Households that need rooms back in service fast can choose low-moisture cleaning, which also conserves water. 
Every visit is competitively priced, backed by our satisfaction guarantee, and performed by the same local crews our reviewers keep asking for by name.

Reduced dry times and lower water use when rooms need to return to service quickly.
